generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The new method `createFailNRequestsHandler` should handle cases where `requestHeaders.get("X-ms-client-request-id")` might return null or an empty list, which could lead to a `NullPointerException`. Consider adding a null check and handling such scenarios gracefully.

The import of `com.sun.net.httpserver.Headers` in `#E0HDK` and its usage in `createFailNRequestsHandler` method (originally in `ResponseInjectingAzureHttpHandler`) are no longer needed since the handler has been moved to `org.elasticsearch.http.ResponseInjectingHttpHandler`. The same applies to the removal of `static org.elasticsearch.repositories.azure.ResponseInjectingAzureHttpHandler.createFailNRequestsHandler;` in `#YMG32`.

The line `final ResponseInjectingHttpHandler.RequestHandler failNRequestRequestHandler = createFailNRequestsHandler(failedBatches);` is redundant because the method `createFailNRequestsHandler` is defined within the same class. It can be directly used without reassigning it to a variable.

If we're good with retrying the whole thing from the start in the event of a throttle, we could do this one level up (where it's async) so we don't have to sleep.
Sleeping seems ok here to me, if we're being throttled on a CAS then we probably shouldn't be freeing up the thread to do some other blob-store operation.
